description: This file defines the Spring Boot configuration class 'SpmConfiguration' which provides bean definitions for the SPM (Survey Performance Management) module of the application. It sets up service beans such as LookupTableService, ScorecardReadPlatformService, ScorecardService, and SpmService, with conditional creation based on missing beans.

classes.name: SpmConfiguration
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class providing bean definitions for various SPM services.

methods.name: lookupTableService
methods.description: Creates and registers a LookupTableService bean if missing.

methods.name: scorecardReadPlatformService
methods.description: Creates and registers a ScorecardReadPlatformService bean if missing.

methods.name: scorecardService
methods.description: Creates and registers a ScorecardService bean if missing.

methods.name: spmService
methods.description: Creates and registers an SpmService bean if missing.
